# std/print

> Print an int, u8, bool or str, followed by a newline.

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/print.pkg) · translated by [bintables/print](../bintables/print.md) · translated by [ctables/print](../ctables/print.md)

```
print 42
print "hello"
print 2 < 3      // true
print 'A'        // 65
```

Each `print` is one or two `write` system calls, so printing in a tight
loop is dominated by system call cost.

## Syntax

Kind: `statement`

```
print {value: expr}
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | expression | any |
